page.home.hero.title: Welcome to REA Legacy SMP.
page.home.hero.description: Build your legacy on REA Legacy SMP. All you have to do is installing an moddable launcer and put our modpack on your client.
page.info.title: Info
page.info.section.title: How to setup my launcer.
page.info.step1: download the mods zip above. This you need to join the server.
page.info.step2.1: Install a louncer that suport mods if you dont already have one. eg:
page.info.step3: Make a new profile. I use Modrinth as example.
page.info.alt1: Image about how to add an profile.
page.info.alt2: In the Image you see an menu with chooses. We choose custom setup.
page.info.step5: Now you need to give the instance an name, select fabric as loader and make sure you set the correct version. (you can find on the lounce page)
page.info.alt3: In the image you see the important settings for teh instance.
page.info.step6: At the Meatball menu (3 dots) you need to select: Open folder. so we come in the files from the instance.
page.info.alt4: In the image you see what you need to open the files.
page.info.step7: Open the mods folder. here you need to place the content from the zip that you can download above.
page.info.step8: You can add some client only mods for yourself. but only if you want.
page.info.step9: Start minecraft trough de modable launcer. So that way it can load your mods
page.info.step10: Wait for the "press enter to enable narator" jumpscare!
page.info.step11: Go to multiplayer and then Add Server.
page.info.alt5: You see how you can add an server in the image
page.info.step12: Give teh server an name. The adress you can ask an admin. Click Done and you can start with building your legacy

page.galery.title: Galery
page.galery.section.title: Galery
page.galery.info1: Welcome to the Legacy Galery. Here you can view screenshots taken in the server. Or add your own.
page.galery.info.screenshot.details1: fill in the form to get your own screenshots added. This be done manualy so it might have some delay.
page.galery.info.screenshot.details2: An Username is not mandatory. You can go anonymous.
page.galery.info.profile.details1: A Profile is what everyone can see. Here you can shortly tell something about you what you do so online.
page.galery.info.profile.details2: You can add links to your social media or websites.
page.galery.info.profile.details3: Your Username in your profile you need to use when uploading an screenshot. So people can go to your profile trough your image.
page.galery.info.profile.details4: This is not mandatory you can go anonymous. And there should be no profile then.
page.galery.info.tips.details1: Here are some tips for nicer screenshots.
page.galery.info.tips.details.tip1: Use F1 to hide the UI.
page.galery.info.tips.details.tip3: Use F2 to only screenshot Minecraft.
